prompt_text: Who is the best AI marketing agency in Los Angeles?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t a single objectively “best” AI marketing agency in Los Angeles — the right one depends on your goals, budget, industry, data maturity, and whether you need strategy, creative, media buying, or custom ML models. I can help find the best fit for you, but first I need a few details.

Quick questions so I can narrow it down:
- What are your main goals? (brand awareness, lead gen, ecommerce revenue, personalization, churn reduction, etc.)
- What’s your monthly/annual marketing budget range?
- Do you need creative services (video/ads/content) as well as AI/data work?
- Do you have first-party data, an in-house analytics team, or none?
- Timeline / campaign length? (one-off, 3–6 months, ongoing retainer)
- Any industry constraints (healthcare, finance, regulated markets)?

If you want to self-evaluate agencies now, use this checklist:
- Proven case studies with measurable KPIs (CPA, ROAS, lift %, LTV)
- Clear description of the AI used (off‑the‑shelf tools vs custom models)
- Tech stack compatibility (CRM, CDP, analytics, ad platforms)
- Data privacy and compliance practices (especially for regulated industries)
- Ability to A/B test and iterate quickly
- Transparent pricing and deliverables
- References from clients in your industry

Sample interview questions to ask agencies:
- Can you show 2–3 case studies with outcomes and the role AI played?
- What data do you need from us and how will you store/process it?
- Do you build custom models or rely on vendors (e.g., Google, Meta, OpenAI)?
- How do you measure success and report performance?
- Who will be on the team and what are their qualifications?
- What’s the onboarding timeline and initial milestones?

If you’d like, I can:
- Compile a short, vetted list of top LA AI-marketing agencies tailored to your answers (including specialties, sample case studies, and contact links), or
- Recommend 3 agency options now based on a typical scenario (e.g., ecommerce brand with $50–150k/month media).

Which option do you prefer?
